description.raw: '''Passive:''' While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
description.text: Passive: While Ranger's Focus is inactive, Ashe's basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Focus for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal '''modified''' physical damage. The flurries [[:Life steal|apply]] [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal and ''[[File:Ashe Frost Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ashe#Frost Shot|An icon for Ashe's ability Frost Shot]] [[Ashe#Frost Shot|Frost Shot]]'' per arrow, but apply [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects only once.

notes.text:
The flurries deal 1 instance of basic damage followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive type of damage (either default or proc).
* The flurries are classified as a basic attack on a script level, but are considered an ability for other effects (e.g. Maokai's Sap Magic).(bug)
The first flurry of a Ranger's Focus cast fires「 one additional arrow, dealing 20% increased total damage. 」「 six arrows, dealing a total of 132 / 138 / 144 / 150 / 156% attack damage. 」
Ranger's Focus works against structures.
Flat damage reductions (e.g. Amumu's Tantrum, Fizz's Nimble Fighter, or Leona's Eclipse) apply per arrow, resulting in extremely increased effectiveness against Ranger's Focus.
* The sole exception is Warden's Mail's Rock Solid, as that applies per cast instance rather than per damage instance.
A flurry can apply 5 stacks of Black Cleaver's Carve to a single target as it deals 5 instances of physical damage.
Ranger's Focus also empowers Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury bolts to become a flurry of 5 bolts each as well.
* The empowered bolts use Ashe's attack projectile, including her missile speed (2500 compared to their default 2000).
* The bolts are evenly distributed among the targets, but a single target cannot be hit by more than 5 bolts.
* These flurries also apply on-hit effects only once to each target hit.
Because Focus stacks are generated on-attack, Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury's bolts will not generate any.
